table.name: Examination
table.purpose: Clinical registry of rheumatic/autoimmune disease patients (dominated by SLE), one row per patient encounter/observation, with diagnoses, serologic test results, coded clinical flags, and recorded complications/events. Dates appear shifted into the future (2045-2054), suggesting de-identified/anonymized data.

col_001.name: patient_id
col_001.description: Patient identifier; near-unique integer, ~4.5% null, no joins detected. Likely a de-identified patient or record number.

col_002.name: visit_or_observation_date
col_002.description: Date of the record, spanning 2045-2054. The future dates indicate anonymized/shifted timestamps; the true meaning (visit date, diagnosis date, or birth date) cannot be distinguished from the data alone.

col_005.name: coded_flag
col_005.description: Only 8 distinct values, all powers of two (0, 4, 16, 64, 256, 1024, 4094, 4096). Strongly suggests a bitmask or bit-encoded category/dose code, but the meaning of each bit is unresolved.

col_006.name: clinical_feature_code
col_006.description: Comma-separated letters from {S, P, D} (e.g., 'S', 'P', 'P,S', 'D,P,S'), 32% null. Looks like a multi-valued categorical code for clinical features/classes; the letters' meanings (e.g., S=serositis, P=proteinuria, D=?) are plausible but unverified.

col_008.name: diagnosis
col_008.description: Diagnosis text using rheumatology abbreviations: SLE (systemic lupus erythematosus), SjS (Sjögren's syndrome), RA (rheumatoid arthritis), MCTD (mixed connective tissue disease), DM (dermatomyositis), ITP, 'susp' = suspected. Multi-valued (comma-separated). 41% null.

col_012.name: complication_or_event
col_012.description: Free-text clinical complication/event: 'CNS lupus', 'brain infarction', 'AMI' (acute myocardial infarction), 'PH' (pulmonary hypertension), 'thrombocytopenia', 'DVT', 'thrombophlebitis', 'Abortion'. Consistent with SLE-related complications; 90% null.

col_013.name: complication_count
col_013.description: Small integer 0-3, mostly 0. Plausibly a count of complications/events (matches col_012 sparsity), but this link is not confirmed.

table.purpose: Each row appears to be a dated observation or test record (many per date, 2037–2055) linked to a parent record in t03 via col_001. The many columns with detection-limit strings ('<0.3', '<40', '>=1000'), qualitative result codes ('+', '2+', '+-', 'TR', '%%'), and dilution-series values (0, 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, 64, 256, 'negative') strongly suggest laboratory assay / measurement results, but the specific domain cannot be determined from the data alone. The future-dated col_002 (2037–2055) is unusual and unexplained; it may be a forecast/scheduled date or a shifted/offset date. Overall the table's exact meaning is unresolved.

col_001.name: t03_reference
col_001.description: Identifier referencing t03.col_001 (many-to-one). Not unique in this table, so it is a foreign key to a parent record, not this table's key.

col_002.name: record_date
col_002.description: Date of the record, ranging 2037-01-27 to 2055-03-04. The future dates are unexplained: it could be a genuine future/scheduled or forecast date, or a date shifted by a fixed offset. Meaning of the date itself (observation date, due date, etc.) is unresolved.

col_007.name: ph_like_measure
col_007.description: Float centered at 7.1, range 0–9.9, one decimal. The distribution is consistent with a pH measurement, but this is only a plausible reading; no confirming evidence.

col_028.name: result_code
col_028.description: Short text code: '-', '0', 'TR', '30', '1', '2', '>=1000', '300', '%%'. Looks like a coded result or flag (e.g. trace/'TR', detection-limit expressions), but the exact code meanings are unknown.

col_032.name: limit_result
col_032.description: Text mixing plain numbers ('5.2', '2.18') with detection-limit notation ('<0.3', '<0.2', '-', '+', '2+'). Consistent with a lab result reported as value-or-below-detection-limit, but the measured quantity is unknown.

col_033.name: qualitative_result
col_033.description: Qualitative result code: '-', '+', '2+', '+-', one stray '7-'. Looks like a graded positive/negative test result, but the test is unknown.

col_034.name: limit_result_2
col_034.description: Text mixing numbers ('19.4', '89.8') with '<40', '<20.5', '<19.5' — a result reported as value-or-below-detection-limit. Measured quantity unknown.

col_037.name: titer_result
col_037.description: Values are 0, 'negative', and powers of two (1, 2, 4, 16, 64, 256). This pattern is characteristic of a serological titer / dilution endpoint, but the specific test is unknown.

col_038.name: titer_result_2
col_038.description: Same pattern as col_037: 0, 'negative', powers of two (1, 2, 8). Likely a titer/dilution result; specific test unknown.

col_039.name: titer_result_3
col_039.description: Same pattern: 0, 'negative', 1, 4, 16. Likely a titer/dilution result; specific test unknown.

col_040.name: titer_result_4
col_040.description: Same pattern: 0, 'negative', powers of two (1, 16, 64, 256). Likely a titer/dilution result; specific test unknown.

col_041.name: titer_result_5
col_041.description: Same pattern: 0, 'negative', 1, 2, 32. Likely a titer/dilution result; specific test unknown.

col_042.name: titer_result_6
col_042.description: Only values '0' and 'negative'. Likely a titer/dilution result (always negative/zero); specific test unknown.

table.name: Patient
table.purpose: Patient-level clinical registry of autoimmune/rheumatic diseases (SLE, Sjögren's syndrome/SJS, rheumatoid arthritis, Behçet's, PSS, etc.). One row per patient, linked to a parent table t02 via col_001. Dates appear shifted into the future (2047–2054), consistent with de-identified/offset dates in a medical dataset (resembles the MIMIC-style date shifting).

col_001.name: patient_id
col_001.description: Primary key of t03; unique integer identifier for each patient record. Referenced by t02.col_001 (many t02 rows to one t03 row), so t03 is the parent/patient table.

col_002.name: sex
col_002.description: Patient sex: F (1023), M (202), with 13 empty values (unknown/unrecorded).

col_003.name: date_of_birth
col_003.description: Patient date of birth (or possibly first-visit/onset date). Values span 1968–2063; the future values suggest the column is date-shifted for anonymization, so the true semantic is likely birth date given the wide multi-decade spread. Alternative reading: date of diagnosis/onset.

col_004.name: followup_or_event_date
col_004.description: A date clustered in 2047–2054 (shifted), 17.4% null. Given the narrow, recent-window clustering and high repetition of specific dates, this is likely a scheduled/recorded follow-up or study visit date. The exact event type cannot be determined from the data alone.

col_005.name: last_visit_or_outcome_date
col_005.description: A second shifted date in 2028–2054, 20.3% null, more spread out than col_004. Plausibly last follow-up/visit or outcome date; the exact meaning is not determinable from values alone.

col_006.name: rh_blood_group
col_006.description: Rh blood group factor: '-' (713), '+' (488), 34 empty, 3 '+(' (likely data-entry artifact for '+').

col_007.name: diagnosis
col_007.description: Diagnosis/disease, mostly coded autoimmune conditions: SLE (systemic lupus erythematosus), SJS (Sjögren's syndrome), RA (rheumatoid arthritis), BEHCET (Behçet's disease), PSS (primary Sjögren's/progressive systemic sclerosis), DM (dermatomyositis), PN susp (suspected polyneuritis). Free-text combos like 'PSS, RA' indicate multiple/comorbid diagnoses; some entries are uncontrolled free text.
